title: Queens that attack exactly k others: A051759(10) = 39302, A051758 for n = 10..14, and the structure of the k = 2 maxima
description: Exhaustive counts of maximal placements of queens on an n x n board in which every queen attacks exactly k others (attacks blocked by the nearest queen), up to the symmetries of the square. k = 3 (OEIS A051759): a(10) = 39302 (314356 placements), counted in 500 parts and checked by Burnside's lemma; it agrees with the n = 10 term of OEIS A051569. k = 2 (OEIS A051758): a(10..14) = 3, 37, 5, 83, 9; ring-restricted counts 177, 367, 749 at n = 15, 17, 19. Includes the structure of the k = 2 maxima with generators for each family, a proof that the 6-turn family is valid for all odd n, conjectured closed forms, search and analysis code, every class representative for n <= 13, and per-part data. Computed by an AI model (Claude Opus 5.5); not peer-reviewed. Each result states its evidence level in the README.
